title: Fushigi Yûgi
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Junior-high student Miaka Yuki is drawn into the book The Universe of the Four Gods, where she becomes priestess of the god Suzaku and must gather seven Celestial Warriors. Her best friend Yui becomes priestess of the rival god Seiryu and turns to jealousy and hatred, while Miaka's love for the warrior Tamahome is tested by war, hostage-taking and brainwashing (Viz blurb via AniList; ANN review).
life_message: Loyal love and friendship can survive betrayal, though jealousy and misunderstanding can turn friends into enemies.

content.note: War between kingdoms, a hostage, brainwashing, warriors fighting (ANN); AniList Action, MU Betrayal, Friends Become Enemies.
Friend turned enemy, brainwashed love interest, emotional melodrama (ANN 'emotionally gripping'); AniList Ghost (spoiler).

folkways.japan: A Japanese shoujo classic drawing on Chinese four-gods mythology; loyalty to friends and the priestess's public duty reflect Japanese group norms.

winners_losers: Miaka and her warriors carry the sympathy; Yui's side is shown as hurt and misled rather than simply evil (ANN).
